context: Two teens chat about a new book release with perks
purpose: Teach: 堂々/気づく/防災/再会/新刊/特典/二度と/柔軟

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、あの作家さんの新刊本、もう予約した?
lines.en: Hey Riku, did you preorder that author's new book yet?
lines.style: Bright excited teen girl asking eagerly with smile

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: もちろん。書店限定の特典がつくって聞いて、すぐ動いたよ。
lines.en: Of course. I heard there's a bookstore-exclusive perk, so I jumped on it.
lines.style: Cool confident teen boy speaking matter-of-factly with pride

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私、昨日やっと気づくことができて、近所の店に走ったら最後の一冊が棚にぽつんと残ってたの。
lines.en: I finally managed to notice yesterday, ran to the local shop, and the last copy was sitting all alone on the shelf.
lines.style: Animated teen girl recounting her lucky story with relief and warmth.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 運いいな。二度とあのシリーズ逃したくないから、俺は発売日に堂々と並ぶつもり。
lines.en: Lucky you. I never want to miss that series again, so I'm planning to boldly line up on release day.
lines.style: Determined teen boy declaring his commitment firmly and proudly

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 並ぶの? 学校の防災訓練と被ってない? 予定そんなに柔軟に動かせるの?
lines.en: You're lining up? Doesn't that clash with the school disaster drill? Can you really shift your plans that flexibly?
lines.style: Concerned teen girl questioning with mild worry in voice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 訓練は午前で終わるから余裕。終わったら駅前で合流して、夏休みぶりの再会みたいに本屋行こうぜ。
lines.en: The drill ends in the morning, so I've got time. After, let's meet at the station and head to the shop like a summer-break reunion.
lines.style: Casual teen boy proposing plans with warmth and easy grin

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいね、行く! 特典のしおり、私が選んでいい?
lines.en: Sounds good, I'm in! Can I be the one to pick the bonus bookmark?
lines.style: Cheerful teen girl agreeing with playful demanding tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 任せた。じゃあ明日、一番乗り目指そうな。
lines.en: All yours. Then tomorrow, let's aim to be first in line.
lines.style: Reassuring teen boy wrapping up with confident grin
